name: Truchet Flow Tiles
desc: An infinite grid of quarter-arc Truchet tiles wired into glowing maze-like loops that scroll and slowly re-roll so the labyrinth perpetually rewrites itself, rendered as multi-hue neon weave, copper circuit traces, leaded stained glass, black-and-white op-art, or braided rope.

density.doc: tile fineness — higher packs smaller tiles (finer maze)

energy.doc: arc glow brightness + tile re-roll activity

scale.doc: stroke weight / weave thickness vs design size

flow.doc: strength of the traveling luminance flow-front sweeping the labyrinth

hue.doc: base ink hue (gradient fans out from here by position)

style.doc: render philosophy — neon-weave / copper circuit / stained glass / op-art B&W / braided rope

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100=opaque bg; lower leaves trails)
